followup_reviews.Research finding: The Togo municipal-election order is supported and remains included as an ordered window, not an observed completed closure. The stated land-frontier coverage includes Ghana, Benin and Burkina Faso. Directional and goods/nationality exceptions are not specified, so unknowns are retained. The official website gives Saturday/Sunday evening; indexed L-Frii gives Sunday/Monday midnight. Preserve correlated alternatives and withhold the spurious independent 0–2-day arithmetic; no actual reopening is inferred. Electoral administration and public-order security are explicitly reported ministerial purposes. The order is not evidence of a distinct trade or migration rationale. The government page and Anadolu were directly read; Anadolu repeats the government origin. L-Frii was available only as indexed text after direct 429. The precise signed order remains missing. The phase remains unlocated and limited to an announced-window display rule. No national physical-enforcement geometry is inferred.
